title: Powered Attack - Pictos Effect & Location (Expedition 33)
description: Powered Attack in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - what this Pictos does and exactly where to find it.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Powered Attack is a Pictos in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33. Effect: Base Attacks deal increased damage.

sections.title: Is It Worth Equipping?
sections.content: Pictos unlock a Lumina after four battles, so equipping it once is enough to keep the effect permanently available for the Lumina cost.
